description: This line plot, titled “ChatGPT on Basketball,” illustrates how three metrics—Accuracy, Confidence, and Alignment—change as a function of Question Popularity, based on the paper “How Knowledge Popularity Influences and Enhances LLM Knowledge Boundary Perception.” The x-axis, labeled “Question Popularity,” spans from 5.0 to 25.0 on a linear scale with tick marks at intervals of 2.5. The y-axis, labeled “Values,” ranges from 0.2 to 1.0, also on a linear scale, with major gridlines and tick labels every 0.1. Three distinct lines represent the metrics: Accuracy (blue circles connected by solid lines) starts at approximately 0.21 at popularity 5.0 and rises steadily to about 0.71 at popularity 25.0. Confidence (green triangles connected by solid lines) begins near 0.72 at popularity 5.0, fluctuates slightly between 0.72 and 0.76 up to popularity 8.0, then increases more consistently to reach 0.93 at popularity 25.0. Alignment (red squares connected by solid lines) starts at 0.49 at popularity 5.0, shows minor fluctuations between 0.50 and 0.55 up to popularity 10.0, then rises steadily to 0.77 at popularity 25.0. All three lines exhibit a general upward trend, indicating that as question popularity increases, ChatGPT’s performance, perceived confidence, and alignment with expected responses also improve.
